atomicity.reason: One obligation: the first publication after a power cycle must match the last value published before shutdown within 2 % of rated capacity.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained: the precondition (no charge left or entered), the event (first publication after a power cycle), the tolerance basis and the purpose are stated in the body.

feasibility.reason: Persisting the last SoC to non-volatile storage and restoring it is routine, and a 2 % tolerance conflicts with none of the other SoC requirements.

parent_fit.reason: Implements the parent's explicit observable: the charge level the vehicle shows does not jump when the vehicle is switched off and on again.

unambiguity.reason: The title says 'within 2 % of the value reported before shutdown' (reads as relative to the value) while the body says '2 % of rated capacity' (absolute points), which give different limits at low SoC, and 'power cycle' does not say whether an abrupt power loss counts as well as an orderly shutdown.
unambiguity.suggestion: Make the title carry the body's basis ('within 2 % of rated capacity') and state whether the requirement covers orderly shutdown only or any power loss.

verifiability.reason: Concrete: with no charge flowing, power-cycle the pack and compare the first published SoC with the last pre-shutdown value; pass if within 2 % of rated capacity (basis stated in the body).

summary: Directly traceable and testable; unambiguity reduced by a title/body mismatch in the tolerance basis (relative vs absolute) and an unstated power-loss scope.
